content.json:
# AKS Platform Health
Production-style Azure Monitor workbook for cluster capacity, node health, pod failures, and restart trends.

content.query:
KubeNodeInventory
| summarize Nodes=count(), Ready=countif(Status == 'Ready') by ClusterName
| extend ReadyPercent=round(100.0 * Ready / Nodes, 2)
content.title: Node Readiness

content.query:
KubePodInventory
| summarize Pods=count(), Running=countif(PodStatus == 'Running'), Pending=countif(PodStatus == 'Pending'), Failed=countif(PodStatus == 'Failed') by ClusterName
content.title: Pod Health

content.query:
KubePodInventory
| summarize Restarts=sum(ContainerRestartCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), Namespace
| render timechart
content.title: Container Restart Trend
